environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on EKS 1.28 cluster. Ingress is handled by AWS ALB Ingress Controller (v2.6.1) with target group binding to the pod. The ALB listener on port 443 is configured with mutual TLS authentication using a trust store (arn:aws:acm-pca::123456789012:certificate-authority/ca-abc123) that issues client certificates only to registered internal services via an automated PKI enrollment pipeline. The listener's MutualAuthentication mode is set to 'passthrough' with the VerifyMode of the backend target group attribute set to require valid x509 client certificate chain rooted in the private CA. Connections without a valid client cert receive TLS handshake failure at the ALB layer before any TCP connection is proxied to the backend pod. Additionally, the cluster uses Cilium CNI with a CiliumNetworkPolicy that restricts pod egress to only the cluster DNS (kube-dns:53/udp) and explicitly enumerated internal service CIDR ranges (10.100.0.0/16), with a default-deny egress rule dropping traffic to link-local (169.254.0.0/16) and external ranges.

config.ingress: AWS ALB with mutual TLS (mTLS) - trust store from ACM PCA private CA, passthrough mode, client cert required
config.imds: IMDSv2 enforced (hop limit 1, pod cannot reach)
